 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-low-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u051/system/state/workspace/programs/task-abbd91ec.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Encode the lengths of all bars: 3s form top row, 2s fill row 2 up to
    # the length of the longest 3-bar; remaining 2s continue on next row.
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != 0)
    n3, n2 = counts[3], counts[2]
    width = max((sum(v == 3 for v in row) for row in grid), default=0)
    width = max(width, n3)
    out = [[3] * width]
    remaining = n2
    row = [0] * width
    take = min(width, remaining)
    # In examples, 2's begin after the first cell in the second row.
    start = 1 if width > 1 else 0
    take = min(width-start, remaining)
    for i in range(start, start+take): row[i] = 2
    remaining -= take
    out.append(row)
    while remaining > 0:
        take = min(width, remaining)
        out.append([2 if i < take else 0 for i in range(width)])
        remaining -= take
    return out
